title: Browns Shoes API Scraper
description: Extract product listings from Browns Shoes using the internal search API only. No DOM parsing and no detail-page crawling.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Optional Browns category URLs. The actor derives cgid/locale from each URL and scrapes those categories via API.

category.title: Category
category.description: Category to scrape when startUrls are not provided.

brand.title: Brand Filter
brand.description: Optional brand filter (normalized to uppercase for API refine filter).

results_wanted.title: Results Wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of products to save.

maxPages.title: Maximum Pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of API pages per category.

pageSize.title: Page Size
pageSize.description: Number of products fetched per API request.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional proxy settings. Leave disabled for local runs unless needed.
